description: Books a treatment for the guest, the same way the spa's website does. The booking is confirmed only when the guest pays by card on the returned pay_url: show it to the guest. Ask the guest first and only call this with customer_consent true. If the time is no longer free, nothing is booked and up to 3 other free times are returned.

customer_consent.description: Must be true: the guest asked for this booking and agrees to be contacted about it

customer_email.description: If given, the guest also gets the pay link by email

idempotency_key.description: Repeating a request with the same key within 24 hours returns the same booking

language.description: Language of the pay page and email

start_time.description: ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-11-20T15:00:00-04:00. Or give date and time.

name: request_booking
title: Request a booking
